ops.body: - [loop] On a tile that peeks at the row's edge, its right-hand Open in Maps and most of its Walk there are off-screen until the row scrolls it in, and scrolling selects that tile (the row's own pattern; open-in-maps-here cold find, Nov 17). Fix, if the owner wants it: the buttons only on the selected tile, or one pair in the row's header for the selected tile

- [loop] A past-10 km tile's "Set as destination" has the hint "Saves it in Navigate; starts nothing", spoken on a phone; react-native-web draws no `accessibilityHint`, so no web journey can read it and only `tileWalk`'s unit test holds it (open-in-maps-here OM7, Nov 17). Fix: a device check, or an `aria-description` on the web

argv: Explore carousel (EC1-EC20, decision 0124; discrete navigation DN1, DN10, DN12, DN13)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, open Explore and tap Open in Maps on a tile, on a card's footer and on a complex's row. **Expect:** Apple Maps opens with walking directions to that place straight from the tap, with no sheet in between; the tile, the card and the row are as they were (OM2, OM4, decision 0191)

argv: Explore carousel (EC1-EC20, decision 0124; discrete navigation DN1, DN10, DN12, DN13)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, on Chronicle's Map, select a place and tap Open in Maps beside Walk here; then long-press the map at street zoom and tap Open in Maps on the card. **Expect:** Apple Maps opens each time, and the place stays selected (OM2, OM4)

argv: Explore carousel (EC1-EC20, decision 0124; discrete navigation DN1, DN10, DN12, DN13)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an Android phone, with a place whose title is your own words, tap Open in Maps on its sheet, then on the walk screen's navigation bar. **Expect:** the maps chooser shows "Destination" or the area's name, never the title (OM10, 0058)

argv: Explore carousel (EC1-EC20, decision 0124; discrete navigation DN1, DN10, DN12, DN13)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone within 2 km of a neighborhood tap Walk there on its tile; then on a town 4 km away; then on a town past 10 km. **Expect:** the first starts a guided, recorded walk at once; the second opens the card asking Walk now / When I get there and starts nothing; the third says "Set as destination", saves it in Navigate and starts nothing (OM7, 0121)
- Both questions above are moot: decision 0191 removed Go here and its sheet (Open in Maps beside Walk). The section is yours to remove.
